BL-1498 — test_handoffd_supervisor.sh has been red on main since 2026-08-22 with no owner, for two independent reasons: the operator's ~/.zshenv prepends ~/.local/bin on every zsh start, so swarm-cleanup.sh (a zsh script) resolves the real 3.7b tmux there instead of the fixture's fake and cases 01 and 05 never see kill-session; and the 2026-09-02 startup-grace hotfix reads case 02's freshly written pid file as a daemon younger than one stall window, so a lingering hung pid is healthy and never halted - the fixture isolates zsh startup files (ZDOTDIR, the BL-1305 shape) and ages its pid file past the stall window, and the file exits 0 from both checkouts
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier on the coder's priority-00 note

  kill-session" (08:12Z, from the BL-1490 parcel). Adjudication and the
